svg.title: Geography Paper 2: items per paper by subtopic and session, May 2019 to November 2025
svg.desc: Heat table. Rows are the nine core subtopics, columns are the past sessions. Each cell is the mean number of questions or sub-questions on that subtopic per paper in that session. Source: the IB question booklets listed on the portal; own tally.
svg.text: Items per paper, mean over time zones: 0 · 1 · 2 · 3 · 4 or more; 0 = subtopic not in that session.
